expression: up = ((est_12m_sal_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_sal_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_sal_num, 1) + (est_12m_cps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_cps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_cps_num, 1) + (est_12m_dps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_dps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_dps_num, 1)) / 3; group_rank(ts_decay_linear(up, 5), sector)
hypothesis: DEU near miss failed only PROD_CORRELATION (0.80) on EBIT upgrades: net upgrade breadth (raised minus lowered) on sales, cash flow and dividend forecasts instead, fields with under 30 alphas.

expression: up = ((est_12m_sal_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_sal_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_sal_num, 1) + (est_12m_net_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_net_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_net_num, 1) + (est_12m_pre_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_pre_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_pre_num, 1) + (est_12m_cps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_cps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_cps_num, 1) + (est_12m_dps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_dps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_dps_num, 1) + (est_12m_ebt_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_ebt_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_ebt_num, 1) + (est_12m_gps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_gps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_gps_num, 1)) / 7; group_rank(ts_decay_linear(up, 5), sector)
hypothesis: Net upgrade breadth averaged over seven forecast items, EBIT left out: broader agreement among analysts, away from the crowded EBIT form.

expression: up = ((est_12m_sal_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_sal_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_sal_num, 1) + (est_12m_cps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_cps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_cps_num, 1) + (est_12m_dps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_dps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_dps_num, 1)) / 3; recs = (rec_raisednum_4wks - rec_lowerednum_4wks) / max(rec_num, 1); group_rank(ts_decay_linear(rank(up) + rank(recs), 5), sector)

expression: up = (est_12m_sal_raisednum_4wks / max(est_12m_sal_num, 1) + est_12m_net_raisednum_4wks / max(est_12m_net_num, 1) + est_12m_pre_raisednum_4wks / max(est_12m_pre_num, 1) + est_12m_cps_raisednum_4wks / max(est_12m_cps_num, 1) + est_12m_dps_raisednum_4wks / max(est_12m_dps_num, 1)) / 5; group_rank(ts_decay_linear(up, 5), sector)
hypothesis: Same form as the near miss (share of raised estimates), other items only: tests whether the items or the net form move production correlation.
